ads.author: Doug Sass
ads.title: Vintage 1979 Taito Space Invaders Part II Cocktail Arcade Cabinet
ads.description: The classic 1980’s video game. This is a vintage 1979 cocktail-style arcade cabinet. It has a wood-grain laminate finish and a glass tabletop. Space Invaders II is the sequel to the original space alien vertical shooter. This is an early Taito direct import from Japan, with Japanese labels. The game was later distributed in North America by Midway as Space Invaders Deluxe. New Gameplay: * Aliens that Split: Certain crab invaders split into two separate shapeshifting units when hit. * Special UFOs: A blinking UFO appears with a random vulnerability state and point values, while later UFOs drop reinforcements. * Save Initials: High score tracking allows players to save their initials for the first time in the series. * Cutscenes: Short animations play between stages showing defeated invaders escaping or sending SOS signals. Power supply, monitor and logic boards have been recapped and tested. Original color CRT. Cabinet is clean and in good condition. No restoration work has been on the cabinet. Coin switch added for freeplay.
